why: This asks whether a prime can be simultaneously Wieferich base 2 and base 3, a pure existence question. Searches found only computational search-bound extensions (PrimeGrid completed search to 2^64 in Dec 2022, pre-snapshot) and general Wieferich prime literature, none of which answers the existence question.
queries: prime p Wieferich base 2 and base 3 simultaneously solved
Wieferich prime base 2 3 simultaneous search bound arXiv 2024 2025
